records.title: Recursive upper bounds via closed form plus nonnegative tail
records.strategy: Prove an exact closed form by induction, then rewrite the bound as a constant minus a nonnegative tail.

records.title: Do not unfold the recurrence at the top-level goal
records.attempted_step: Run `simp [Seq]` before building the closed form.
records.failure_signal: The goal grows but still has no inequality route.
records.better_direction: Split the work: derive the exact form first, then close the inequality with the tail sign.

records.title: Use repository-relative evidence paths
records.rule: Every memory note should cite repository-relative file paths.
records.reason: Absolute paths become stale in handoff documents.

records.title: `positivity` can finish tail-sign subgoals
records.why_it_matters: Once the denominator is visibly positive, automation can often close the tail positivity step.
